mappings.applicability_reason: The corpus holds content with differing read entitlements -- every workspace's resolved tickets -- and retrievals are served to every signed-in user of every workspace, so retrieval must be filtered by the requester's authorization.
assumptions: No common false positive applies: the architecture overview affirmatively states that relevance alone selects the passages that reach the prompt from the one shared index -- a documented absence of an entitlement filter, not an unstated mechanism.
